title: Fudgy Chocolate and Walnut Cakes
subtitle: with Chocolate Sauce and Strawberries
description: Fudgy, gooey, nutty, chocolatey cakes – is there a better way to celebrate the festive season? Serve with sweet strawberries and drizzles of chocolate sauce and cream for extra delicious decadence.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 160C. Spray or brush 2 ramekins (185ml/¾ cup capacity) with cooking oil and put on an oven tray (see Kitchen hack). Finely chop the walnuts. Halve the strawberries, removing the green tops if desired. Put the strawberries and 2 tsp sugar in a bowl, toss to combine well, then set aside to macerate until needed.

Melt chocolate: Coarsely chop the chocolate. Put 75g chocolate (just under ½ cup), 60ml (¼ cup) cream and 25g butter in a heatproof bowl. Set the bowl over a small saucepan of gently simmering water and stir until melted and smooth. Remove the bowl from the heat and cool for 5 mins.

Make cake batter: Add the walnuts, coconut, 1½ tbs plain flour and 1½ tbs sugar to the chocolate mixture and stir to combine. Add 1 egg and stir to combine well. Divide the batter evenly among the prepared ramekins. Bake for 25-28 mins until the tops are just firm. Remove from the oven and stand for 5 mins.

Make chocolate sauce: Meanwhile, put the remaining chocolate and 1½ tbs cream in a heatproof bowl. Set the bowl over a small saucepan of gently simmering water and stir until melted and smooth. Remove the bowl from the heat.
Serve up: Run a knife around the ramekins to release the cakes, then carefully invert onto plates. Drizzle with the chocolate sauce and 80ml (⅓ cup) cream, spoon over the strawberries and enjoy!

Kitchen hack: If you don't have ramekins, simply pour the cake batter into a greased small (15cm base measurement) non-stick ovenproof frypan or saucepan and bake in the oven for 20 mins or until just firm to touch. Remove from the oven and cut into wedges to serve.
